The AAII is a comprehensive indexing method that combines multiple individual benchmarks across areas such as knowledge, reasoning, and coding into a single score.   
   
 While useful for comparing the overall intellectual capacity of models with a single figure, scores fluctuate significantly depending on which benchmarks are grouped together. [...] In the second-round Dokpamo evaluation, benchmark testing accounts for 40 out of a total 100 points, with the AAII making up 25 points and the National Information Society Agency (NIA) benchmark evaluation accounting for 15 points.   
   
 The remaining weights consist of expert evaluations (35 points) and user evaluations (25 points).
